selected_script.angle: Clumsy spray bottle and paper towel fail vs. easy one-handed glove wipe for quick daily touch-ups
selected_script.hook: Owner juggling a spray bottle and paper towel, dog pulls paw away as the paper shreds into a messy clump

video_001.visual: 0-3s: Handheld close-up showing a person clumsily holding a spray bottle in one hand and a thin paper towel in the other, trying to wipe a calm dog's paw; the paper towel shreds and leaves wet clumps on the fur. 3-5s: Extreme close-up on the frustrating mess of wet paper bits stuck to the dog's paw, highlighting the annoying inefficiency. 5-8.5s: The person's hand reaches into a royal-blue pouch with an orange header, pulls out a soft, white, five-finger moist nonwoven glove wipe with raised pearl-like 3D dots. The person wears the glove and gently wipes the dog's paw with one easy, smooth hand motion. 8.5-10s: Close-up of the clean, residue-free dog paw beside the dirty textured glove, proving the mess is gone, as the person gives the dog a quick gentle pat.
video_001.audio: I used to juggle sprays and paper towels just to clean up after a walk. It always shredded and left an annoying mess. Then I switched to these textured grooming gloves. One quick wipe and we're done. So much easier.
